metadata.hash_projection_rule: evidence_policy_definition_hash = H_WCJ(policy_definition) - metadata is OUTSIDE the hash input (RV6 s2 / pN C2). policy_definition contains ASCII keys and ASCII string, integer, and boolean values only - no floats, no null, no non-ASCII (RV7 R-4 corrected wording). For this subset, H_WCJ equals sha256 of RFC8785-canonical JSON (UTF-16 and ASCII key orders coincide).
metadata.informative_non_learned_grade_bound: SCRIPTED/WAIT reach HASH_BOUND_REPRODUCED(3); EXACT_TRAIN_TIME(4) unreachable (train-time-only proofs); same closed-loop ceiling row as HB so no functional loss (G-4)
metadata.informative_rv7_delta: v1.8 folds RV7 P0-2 (resolver signature + precedence), P0-3 (projection_rules member with golden vectors), P0-4 (CONFIG_HASH total map replaces stage discriminator), P0-6 (evaluation certificate wiring), R-4 (this metadata type wording). Semantic change - definition hash and file sha differ from the v1.7 line (066eed1049f4... / ed10c77a... are no longer pins, per RV7).

claim_targets._rule: EvidenceRecord.claim_target_hash MUST equal the hash derived from the component's target below (mismatch = E_PROOF_MISBOUND). Single reproduction/binding anchor for every component (RV6 s3 / pN C1). The two *_projection targets are defined exactly in projection_rules (RV7 P0-3).

projection_rules._rule: Exact keyed objects for the two projection claim targets (RV7 P0-3). All other H_WCJ targets hash the typed spec object itself per design s2.3 composite rules (keyed object, enum .value strings, frozenset as bytes-ascending array) - already unambiguous, no projection needed.

control_mode_projection.object: the canonical slot object of the control_mode slot per design s2.3: {"state":"KNOWN","value":"<ControlMode member name>"}
control_mode_projection.precondition: certified definitions always have control_mode KNOWN: EXPLICIT_NONE is type-forbidden on ControlModeSlot (E_SLOT_FORBIDDEN_NONE, design s1.1) and UNKNOWN slots are not certifiable (Draft only) - therefore no sentinel encoding for EXPLICIT_NONE/UNKNOWN exists or is needed

handoff_schema_projection.tuple_order: declared tuple order preserved for BOTH arrays - no second canonical order is introduced; reordering a tuple changes SkillDefinitionHash and this claim target coherently (design s3-4 BehaviorSignature also sees the reorder)
handoff_schema_projection.fields_element_type: SemanticFieldSpec {field_id, dtype, shape, unit, frame} (design s1.4 - pinned by RV7 P0-3)
handoff_schema_projection.empty_tuple: empty tuple serializes as []; EXPLICIT_NONE/UNKNOWN states do not exist for tuple-typed definition fields (type level) - only slots have states

proof_policy._domain: (component_kind, evidence_grade, applicability_class) -> exact required ProofKind set; REQUIRED cells only; UNKNOWN grade carries no authority-relevant claim

reproduced_output_rule.note: reproduction anchor for EVERY component including S-group (pN C1 closure); FINAL_ARTIFACT_HASH is NOT required in S cells because claim_target_hash is the anchor there

bindings.rule: artifact_hash == claim_target_hash of the claimed component

bindings.totality_note: RV7 P0-4: disjoint whens, total over (identity_kind, training_lineage, component) - LEARNED x NOT_APPLICABLE is impossible by kind-family coherence (design s3); no stage field exists on EvidenceRecord/ProofItem - this map replaces the former stage discriminator; TRAINING_DATASET under BC_THEN_RL binds bc_config_hash because the demo dataset is a BC-stage input, so the BC config is attested through the TD claim while all other components anchor to the final-stage config

bindings.rule: artifact_hash == normalization slot hash when KNOWN; EXPLICIT_NONE slot makes the claim N/A
artifact_hash = binding blob sha256; blob binds (claim_target_hash, train_run_manifest_hash)
artifact_hash == EvidenceRecord.evaluator_artifact_hash AND member of evaluator_registry
artifact_hash = manifest sha256; manifest content lists claim_target_hash
artifact_hash = doc sha256; empty set = explicit empty doc
artifact_hash = H_WCJ of path-sha object array, path bytes ascending

resolvers.name: resolve_artifact
resolvers.contract: (ref, expected_sha256) -> bytes | UNRESOLVED; unresolved or zero-length or sha-mismatch = E_PROOF_ARTIFACT_UNRESOLVED

resolvers.name: resolve_git_commit
resolvers.contract: (commit_id_40hex) -> exists | UNRESOLVED; used for SOURCE_COMMIT which carries no artifact_hash; unresolved = E_PROOF_ARTIFACT_UNRESOLVED

evaluator_registry_rule.membership: EvidenceRecord.evaluator_artifact_hash must be a member of the evaluator_registry passed to certify_definition
evaluator_registry_rule.certificate_binding: ContractCertificate.evaluator_registry_hash = H_WCJ of sorted evaluator artifact hashes

evaluation_certificates.issued_by: certify_definition issues one EvidenceEvaluationCertificate per evaluated EvidenceRecord; canonical order = component_kind.value bytes ascending (RV7 P0-6)
evaluation_certificates.grade_agreement: EvidenceRecord.grade must equal assigned_grade; mismatch = E_GRADE_MISMATCH (fail-closed - grade is a measured value, not self-asserted)
evaluation_certificates.result_binding: ContractCertificate.evidence_evaluation_bundle_hash = H_WCJ(issued evaluation certificates in canonical order)
evaluation_certificates.eligibility_source: evaluate_usage_eligibility consumes assigned_grade from the evaluation certificates, verified against certificate.evidence_evaluation_bundle_hash (mismatch = E_CERT_INPUT_MISMATCH)

applicability_rules.resolver_signature: resolve_applicability(identity_kind, training_lineage, explicit_none_components, requested_profile, component) -> REQUIRED(min_grade) | NOT_APPLICABLE | OPTIONAL
applicability_rules.note: RV7 P0-2 supersedes ApplicabilityResolver(kind, lineage, component) and the former instance->lineage->profile->default order. requested_profile is null at certification (profile-neutral) - layer 2 is then skipped.

applicability_rules.invariant: NOT_APPLICABLE is not UNKNOWN; N/A = validated absence excluded from aggregation; UNKNOWN = rank 0, disqualifying, never exempt

applicability_rules.regression_vector: requested_profile=OFFLINE_REPLAY, identity_kind=LEARNED, training_lineage=BC_ONLY, component=TRAINING_DATASET -> NOT_APPLICABLE at layer 2 (the v1.7.1 order wrongly yielded REQUIRED at the lineage layer before the profile dash cell was consulted - RV7 P0-2)

not_applicable.TRAINING_PROVENANCE: provenance does not affect replay validity; recording duty stays

usage_ceiling.rule: usage matrix is a ceiling not an authority grant
usage_ceiling.closed_loop_authority: requires evaluate_authority_grant conjuncts: acceptance_test, two_key_O0_S0_V0, independent_safety_gate
